_comment: Copy to acceptance.json and edit per app. scripts/acceptance.sh reads it after
its generic checks (root reachable, no scaffold/placeholder text, og:image
resolves, a sign-in route is linked).
paths:        every public route that must return 200 and carry no placeholder
text. List the ones a real visitor actually reaches.
must_contain: path -> a literal string that proves the page rendered its DATA,
not just its chrome. This is the check that catches a page which
is technically 200 but empty because a publish job never ran.
Keep must_contain values stable — a headline you would not casually reword, or
a structural class name. Do not assert on live numbers; they change.
